content:
以下是機器翻譯內容：

> 由於許多 Mod 只有英文，非英語母語玩家玩起來可能有些吃力，Mod 作者接受翻譯 PR 的時間不確定，且不一定有人翻譯。為了解決這些痛點，開發了這個 Mod。

> Since many mods are only in English, it may be difficult for non-English native players to play. The time it takes for mod authors to accept translation PRs is uncertain, and there may not necessarily be someone to translate them. In order to solve these pain points, I developed this Mod.

# 功能

## 自動翻譯無當前語言翻譯的語言檔案

自動翻譯後載入，並非官方載入資源包形式，在遊戲目錄下有個 AutoTranslation 資料夾，未翻譯部分的原始檔案與翻譯檔案都有，可以潤飾後打包成資源包；

## 螢幕翻譯

此功能需要在快捷鍵設定裡設定快捷鍵後，開啟要需要翻譯的介面，然後按下快捷鍵，該功能應該能翻譯大多數使用了原始 Screen 渲染機制的 Mod；

## 豐富的設定項目

透過 Mod 設定選單，可以設定 Mod 所需參數，具體可在遊戲中查看。

- - -

## Automatically translate language files that do not have the current language translation

Load after automatic translation. It is not an official resource package. There is an Auto Translation folder in the game directory. There are original files and translated files for the untranslated parts, which can be polished and packaged into a resource package；
## Screen translation

This function requires setting the shortcut key in the shortcut key settings, opening the interface that needs to be translated, and then pressing the shortcut key. This function should be able to translate most Mods that use the original Screen rendering mechanism；

## Rich configuration items

Through the Mod configuration menu, you can configure the parameters required by the Mod, which can be viewed in the game.

# 翻譯 API (Translation API)

## Google

Mod 預設翻譯引擎為 Google。

The default translation engine of the Mod is Google.

## 其他 (Other)

目前 Mod 僅整合了 Google 翻譯，若需其他翻譯 API，需等待開發，或自行開發，僅需實作介面 ITranslator，然後呼叫 TranslatorManager.registerTranslator(String name, Supplier<ITranslator> getInstance) 即可，然後透過設定項目可切換翻譯 API。

Currently, Mod only integrates Google Translator. If you need other translation APIs, you need to wait for development or develop it yourself. You only need to implement the interface ITranslator, and then call Translator Manager.registerTranslator(String name, Supplier<ITranslator> getInstance), and then The translation API can be switched through configuration items.
